name: in_cylinder_htc_correlations
title: In-cylinder heat-transfer correlations for reciprocating machines (function library)
summary: Seven EES FUNCTIONs returning the Nusselt number of the in-cylinder gas of a reciprocating compressor, expander or engine: Annand 1963, Woschni 1967, Adair 1972, Destoop 1986, Gnielinski 2010 (pipe equation with the mean piston speed), Irimescu 2013 (Gnielinski with the wall-viscosity ratio) and the Kornhauser 1994 gas-spring correlation, plus the geometry and crank-kinematics helpers of the ThermoCycle reciprocating package (piston speed, cylinder volume, hydraulic and equivalent diameters, wall area, Adair swirl velocity with its smooth transition). The heat-transfer coefficient follows from h = Nu*lambda/Gamma and is evaluated in the demonstration program; transport properties are arguments, so the library works with any gas.

authors: R. P. Adair, E. B. Qvale and J. T. Pearson (Adair 1972 correlation)
A. Kornhauser and J. Smith (Kornhauser 1994 correlation)
